fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Losing a filling can be unsettling. You might notice a gap, a rough edge or sudden sensitivity when eating or drinking. While a lost filling is not always painful, the exposed tooth is more vulnerable to decay, food trapping and fracture. At Precision Dental, we can see you promptly to protect and restore the tooth.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is a Lost Filling?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A filling repairs part of a tooth that has been affected by decay or damage. Over time, fillings can wear, crack or come loose. Common reasons include new decay developing around or beneath the filling, biting on hard or sticky foods, grinding or clenching, an old filling reaching the end of its lifespan, or a crack in the surrounding tooth.

sections.label: What to Do Before Your Appointment

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What to Do Before Your Appointment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Rinse your mouth gently with warm water and keep the area clean by brushing carefully. Chew on the other side, and avoid sticky, hard, sugary and very hot or cold foods. Temporary filling material from a pharmacy can help protect the tooth for a short time. If there is pain, take over-the-counter pain relief as directed if suitable for you.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We examine the tooth and take digital X-rays if needed to check for decay and assess how close the cavity is to the nerve. We explain what we find and the most suitable way to restore the tooth. For many teeth, we clean the area, remove any decay and place a new white filling that is matched to your tooth colour. If a large part of the tooth is missing or weakened, an inlay, onlay or crown may offer better protection, and many of these can be made in one visit with CEREC. If the nerve is affected, root canal therapy may be needed.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Wait until the anaesthetic has worn off before eating. Mild sensitivity is common for a few days. Contact us if your bite feels uneven or sensitivity lingers. Brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste, clean between your teeth, and attend regular check-ups so we can monitor your fillings over time.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for a Lost Filling

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for a Lost Filling

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We offer prompt appointments, tooth-coloured materials and digital imaging to assess the tooth accurately. With CEREC available in our practice, we can also provide more protective restorations in a single visit when a filling alone is not enough.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Is a lost filling an emergency?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: It is not always urgent, but the tooth is exposed and can decay or break. It is best to be seen within a day or two, or sooner if you have pain.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I keep the old filling?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Old fillings cannot be reused, so there is no need to keep them. A new filling will be placed.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Why is my tooth so sensitive now?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Without a filling, the inner layer of the tooth, called dentine, may be exposed, which can cause sensitivity.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can a lost filling cause an infection?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If left untreated, bacteria can reach deeper into the tooth, potentially leading to pain and infection.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will the new filling be tooth-coloured?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: In most cases, yes. We use composite resin matched to your tooth shade.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long does it take to replace a filling?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Most fillings can be replaced in a single appointment, typically within 30 to 60 minutes.
